question.text: A body floats with $\frac{1}{\mathrm{n}}$ of its volume keeping outside of water. If the body has been taken to height h inside water and released, it will come to the surface after time t. Then

solution.text:
$F_B=m g ; V\left(1-\frac{1}{n}\right) \sigma g=V d g, \Rightarrow d=\left(\frac{n-1}{n}\right) \sigma$
$a=\frac{F_b-m g}{m}=\frac{v \sigma g}{m}-g, \quad a=\frac{v \sigma g}{v\left(\frac{n-1}{n}\right) \sigma}-g, \quad \Rightarrow a=\frac{n g}{n-1}-g_n \Rightarrow a=\frac{g}{n-1}$ Now for time, $h=\frac{1}{2} a t^2, h=\frac{1}{2} \frac{g}{(n-1)} t^2, \Rightarrow t=\sqrt{\frac{2 h}{g}(n-1)}=\Rightarrow t \alpha \sqrt{n-1}$
